## Pack details

- Pack name and kind
- What it contains
- Author or creator of each asset
- Original source links
- Licence and a link to its terms or permission to redistribute
- Attribution exactly as it should appear
- Changes made to third-party assets, if any

## Preview and files

Link to a preview you can share publicly. A sample or download link is welcome when redistribution is permitted. If any permissions are still unclear, tell us which assets need review.

[Content pack formats and publishing guide](https://github.com/cntrl-alt-lenny/edopro-hd-cards/blob/main/docs/content-packs.md)
